stories.title: Noel Tata pushes for board restructuring at Tata Sons
stories.summary: Noel Tata has requested a revision of the Tata Sons board agenda, seeking to prioritise his own restructuring proposals. The company recently moved its board meeting from November 26 to November 30 to accommodate a mandatory notice period. The agenda is currently under review.

stories.title: Noel Tata seeks priority for restructuring proposals
stories.summary: Noel Tata has objected to the agenda for the November 30 Tata Sons board meeting, demanding his restructuring and liquidity proposals be heard before the company's listing plans. He cited Article 121B of the Articles of Association to justify his request for priority.

stories.title: Tata Steel evaluates APL Apollo deal structure
stories.summary: Tata Steel is reviewing its proposed transaction with APL Apollo Tubes following investor backlash. CEO T.V. Narendran confirmed management teams are discussing potential changes to address shareholder concerns. The revised structure has not yet been presented to the board of either company.

stories.title: Tata Steel and APL Apollo reconsider deal terms
stories.summary: Tata Steel is in talks with APL Apollo Tubes to rework their strategic deal after shareholders raised concerns over debt and financial implications. While the transaction remains active, the company is exploring structural changes to protect minority interests. No details on the revised arrangement have been provided.

stories.title: Tata Steel-APL Apollo deal: InGovern seeks SEBI scrutiny, minority shareholder safeguards - Moneycontrol.com
Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down
stories.summary: Flipkart Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy will depart in the coming weeks after a decade in the role. Chief Product and Technology Officer Balaji Thiagarajan will lead the company alongside the board during the transition. A successor is expected to be announced shortly.

stories.title: Cognizant in talks for S&P Global operations
stories.summary: Cognizant is negotiating a deal to take over parts of S&P Global's Capital IQ operations in India. The arrangement could see approximately 1,500 staff members move to the IT services firm's payroll. The companies have not yet finalised the transfer.

stories.title: PhonePe revives IPO plans for 2027
stories.summary: PhonePe plans to list in early 2027 with a target valuation of up to $15 billion. The fintech firm expects to raise between $1.2 billion and $1.5 billion through an offer for sale. Updated draft papers are expected within the next 45 days.

stories.title: Walmart-backed PhonePe restarts IPO process, eyes up to $15 billion valuation in market debut, source says - Reuters
PhonePe targets February-March 2027 for IPO
stories.summary: PhonePe has revived its IPO plans, targeting a listing in February or March 2027 at a valuation of $12 billion to $15 billion. The offering will consist entirely of an offer for sale by existing shareholders. The company plans to file its revised prospectus soon.

stories.title: PhonePe resumes IPO process
stories.summary: PhonePe has revived its IPO plans after previously deferring them due to market volatility. The company is targeting a February-March 2027 listing at a valuation of $12 billion to $15 billion. The offering will be an offer for sale, with revised papers expected shortly.

stories.title: Tata Steel agrees to buy stake in APL Apollo
stories.summary: Tata Steel has signed an agreement to acquire a 26.38 percent stake in APL Apollo Tubes for up to Rs 32,266 crore. The announcement prompted a decline in share prices for both companies as investors questioned the deal's valuation and the resulting debt burden.

stories.title: Dunearn Investments sells 2.4 percent stake in Medanta
stories.summary: Dunearn Investments sold a 2.4 percent stake in Medanta for Rs 930 crore through a block deal on the National Stock Exchange. Buyers included HDFC Mutual Fund and Norges Bank. The transaction was executed at an average price of Rs 1,460 per share.

stories.title: Carlyle Group sells 7.4 percent stake in Piramal Pharma
stories.summary: CA Alchemy Investments, an affiliate of the Carlyle Group, sold a 7.41 percent stake in Piramal Pharma for Rs 2,211 crore. The shares were purchased by mutual funds managed by Aditya Birla Sun Life and Axis Bank. Carlyle's remaining stake now stands at 10.52 percent.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty recover from Monday sell-off
stories.summary: Indian equity markets staged a recovery on Wednesday, with the Sensex rising 1,502 points to close at 83,938.28. Gains in banking and consumer stocks helped benchmarks offset Monday's losses. Easing crude oil prices and foreign fund inflows contributed to the positive sentiment.

stories.title: Nifty 50 eyes 26,000 after 1,502-point Sensex gain
stories.summary: The Sensex rose 1,502 points on Wednesday, pushing the Nifty 50 above 25,800. Market participants are now targeting 26,000 as the next level. Despite the rally, October CPI inflation was reported at 6.09 percent, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit.

stories.title: Sensex climbs 1,502 points as FMCG stocks rally
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex rose 1.82 percent to 83,938.28 on Wednesday, recovering all of Monday's losses. The Nifty 50 gained 1.85 percent to 25,819.25, led by Hindustan Unilever and private banks. The index reached its highest level in approximately six months.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty post best session since November 6
stories.summary: Benchmark indices surged nearly 2 percent on Wednesday, marking their strongest performance since November 6. Easing commodity prices and a stronger rupee boosted largecap stocks, with Hindustan Unilever recording its largest gain since June 2024. Over 80 percent of index constituents finished in the green.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty rally as banking and consumer stocks gain
stories.summary: Indian equity markets posted strong gains Wednesday, with the Sensex rising 1,502 points to close at 83,938. Investors increased holdings in banking and consumer goods stocks, supported by global conditions. The rally followed Monday's profit-taking session, with the Nifty recovering above the key technical level of 25,650.

stories.title: Nasdaq recovers from steep sell-off
stories.summary: The Nasdaq Composite plunged 4.6% Wednesday before trimming losses to 0.8% by late afternoon. The sell-off was fueled by concerns over artificial intelligence investments, accelerating inflation, and new tariff plans. Markets remain sensitive to the pace of capital expenditure and the potential returns from data center infrastructure.

stories.summary: The technology-heavy Nasdaq 100 index slumped for a second consecutive session on Wednesday, briefly slipping into bear-market territory, as investors continued to dump AI-linked stocks amid mounting concerns over excessive investments in the sector and rising borrowing costs, while fresh US data showed inflation accelerating in October. stories.title: Wall Street Futures Point to Sharp Losses as Technology Stocks Face Renewed Selling Pressure: Dow Jones, S&P, Nasdaq
stories.summary: US stock index futures pointed to a sharply lower opening on Wednesday as renewed weakness across technology and artificial intelligence-related stocks threatened to extend losses following Tuesday's mixed trading session. stories.title: RBI repatriates 60 tonnes of gold
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India brought 60 tonnes of gold back to domestic vaults between April and September 2026. This brings the total domestic share of gold reserves to 84 percent, up from 77 percent in March. The central bank cites rising geopolitical uncertainty for the move.

stories.summary: Mumbai: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has stepped up the repatriation of its gold reserves as central banks globally reassess the risks of holding sovereign assets overseas amid growing geopolitical uncertainty. stories.title: Government confirms UPI remains free for consumers
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry stated that UPI will remain free for consumers and all person-to-person transactions. Any future merchant discount rate charges would apply only to a limited set of transactions above a specific threshold. The government says the policy ensures the long-term sustainability of the payment system.

stories.title: EPFO eyes minimum UPI withdrawal of ₹1,000
stories.summary: The EPFO is considering a ₹1,000 minimum for UPI withdrawals to reduce transaction processing loads. Officials state the technology is ready following successful testing, though migration to the new CITES 2.0 platform currently faces technical glitches. The system is designed to improve efficiency, pending software stability.

stories.title: Navi gains UPI market share as leaders slip
stories.summary: Navi's share of the UPI market rose to 5.04% in October 2026, up from 4.76% in September, according to NPCI data. The fintech platform processed 1.27 billion transactions during the month. Meanwhile, market leaders PhonePe, Google Pay, and Paytm saw their collective share decline.

stories.title: What the RBI's Draft Model Risk Guidance Means for AI Agents in Banks
Zytra AI releases banking safety benchmark
stories.summary: Zytra AI has released FinProof, a safety evaluation benchmark for banking and financial services. The tool is now available under a CC BY 4.0 license on HuggingFace. The company describes it as the first publicly available AI safety benchmark built specifically for the financial sector.

stories.summary: Modern issuing doesn’t only evolve technological change, it requires operating model transformation.

stories.title: Small finance banks lead fixed deposit rates
stories.summary: Suryoday Small Finance Bank is offering 8.25% interest on five-year fixed deposits, leading the category. Jana Small Finance Bank follows at 7.77%, while large lenders like HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank offer 6.60%. Savers continue to seek predictable returns as rates vary significantly across institutions.

stories.title: Gold loan market expands to ₹23.3 lakh crore
stories.summary: India's gold loan market grew 60.6% year-on-year to ₹23.3 lakh crore in September 2026. Borrowers are increasingly using pledged jewellery to fund business operations and planned expenses rather than just as emergency safety nets. Rising gold prices have allowed for larger loan amounts against existing assets.

stories.title: Financial rule changes arrive for December
stories.summary: December brings revised charges on SBI credit card transactions, new margin requirements for commodity derivatives, and updated digital KYC rules for overseas investors. SBI Card users will face a 1% fee on certain high-value transportation and fuel transactions starting December 1. Change is scheduled for the month.

stories.title: Pensioners face November 30 life certificate deadline
stories.summary: Pensioners must submit annual life certificates by November 30. While the government's Jeevan Pramaan digital facility is available for most, those who have remarried or are re-employed remain ineligible and must visit a pension office in person. The system is intended to make life easier.

stories.title: The three-account strategy: How a 23-year-old woman builds wealth and funds her father’s international trip | Mint
stories.summary: Managing personal finances in your 20s can be challenging, particularly when balancing lifestyle expenses, savings and long-term investments. However, a 23-year-old woman, Shreya, has shared a three-bucket money management strategy that has helped her achieve financial independence at an early age and even sponsor an international holiday for her father.

stories.title: AFT grants pension to disabled son after 50 years
stories.summary: The Armed Forces Tribunal has ordered the Centre to grant a lifelong family pension to a 68-year-old disabled man, five decades after his father's death. The tribunal ruled that missing service records cannot bar the benefit. Arrears must be released with 6% annual interest.

stories.title: Government outlines family benefits after employee death
stories.summary: The government provides family pension, death gratuity, and insurance payouts to families of deceased or missing employees. To mitigate financial uncertainty, authorities have mandated a 15-day deadline for sanctioning provisional family pensions after a claim is received. Rules exist to ensure support while paperwork is processed.

stories.title: US accuses India of manufacturing overcapacity
stories.summary: The US Trade Representative has accused India of creating structural excess capacity through industrial schemes like Make in India. The report alleges these practices pose challenges to US businesses and workers. India has rejected the claims, stating no sector has overproduction as it currently faces existing tariffs.

stories.title: India rejects US excess capacity allegations
stories.summary: India has rejected US claims of structural excess capacity, which Washington is citing to impose tariffs on 14 economies. The government stated it does not have excess capacity in any sector and remains committed to concluding a trade deal with the US as early as possible.

stories.title: India seeks trade deal to address US tariff threat
stories.summary: The US has proposed tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods, citing structural excess capacity. The rate could drop to 17% if a trade deal is reached. India rejected the capacity claims and suggested that trade concerns should be addressed through bilateral negotiations.

stories.title: India disputes US tariff proposal
stories.summary: The US proposed 25% tariffs on Indian imports, with a provision to cap them at 17% if a bilateral trade agreement is signed. India rejected the allegation of structural excess manufacturing capacity and reiterated its commitment to working with Washington for an early trade deal.

stories.title: US announces new tariffs on global imports
stories.summary: The US plans to impose new tariffs on goods from India, China, and the EU. Imports from China face a 20% rate, potentially doubling to 40% if talks fail. Indian products would face a 17% charge if a trade pact is finalised, or higher if negotiations stall.

stories.title: Trump administration proposes new import duties for 14 nations
stories.summary: The Trump administration plans to impose new import taxes on 14 trading partners, including India, to rebuild a tariff agenda previously found unconstitutional by the Supreme Court. Rates for Chinese imports could reach 40 percent if current talks fail. The agenda is being rebuilt from the ground up.

stories.title: US targets 14 trading partners with new industrial capacity tariffs
stories.summary: The US Trade Representative has proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners to combat what it calls structural excess industrial capacity. The move follows an eight-month investigation into unfair trade practices. Washington blames these nations for flooding global markets with cheap exports. The capacity remains, for now, excess.
